notes: New layout. Home is now the day Schedule: appointments with time, operatory, dentist/hygienist, procedures, confirmation and notes; previous/next day, Today and a date picker; show/hide operatories and hide completed (remembered on each device). Clicking a patient opens the new Patient page: follow-up status (with the full follow-up window), saved treatment plans (print as before), unscheduled treatment, appointments and tasks. Patient search is in the top bar on every page (press / to jump to it). 'Today' is renamed Follow-ups; the separate Treatment Plans page is gone.
